summary: Provides details on how to log in to the ERP system, the dashboard interface, user-specific views, and session management.
steps: Log in using your phone number and OTP.
Optionally, set a password for future logins.
business_rules: Login is primarily via phone number and OTP.
The dashboard displays your company/entity name and user ID.
The interface is permission-based, showing options relevant to your role (e.g., fee options for a fee clerk).
The system supports multiple user sessions.
important_notes: Users can attach the URL to their homescreen for quick access.
questions: How do I log in to the ERP system?
What is the URL for ERP login?
How can I set a password for my ERP account?
What information is displayed on the ERP dashboard?
Is the ERP interface customized based on user roles?
